name: Dhan Singh Gurjar
role: Kotwal linked to the Meerut outbreak
contribution: Dhan Singh Gurjar was the kotwal of Meerut associated with the outbreak of the 1857 rebellion and the release of imprisoned sepoys on 10 May.
context: Meerut was the uprising's initial major flashpoint, where sepoy resistance, local participation, and attacks on Company authority quickly converged.
impact: Dhan Singh's story represents the role of local police and civilian actors in the Meerut outbreak and complicates accounts that describe 1857 only as a military mutiny.
highlight: Meerut kotwal associated with the outbreak of the 1857 rebellion.
seoTitle: Dhan Singh Gurjar: Meerut Kotwal of the 1857 Uprising
seoDescription: Learn about Dhan Singh Gurjar, the Meerut kotwal associated with the opening outbreak of the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
shortAnswer: Dhan Singh Gurjar was Meerut's kotwal, associated with the local outbreak of the 1857 rebellion.
